title: A bus driver and a war tax

exchanges.q: Please state your name for the record.
What did you do for work?
exchanges.a: I was a driver for a bus company in {CITY} for six years.

exchanges.q: When did you receive the first call?
exchanges.a: On the third of May 2022, at about eleven at night.

a: He said that I had to pay a war tax of one thousand dollars.
He said that if I did not pay, they would burn my bus with me inside.

exchanges.q: How many calls did you receive?
exchanges.a: Five calls in total, over two months. The last call was in July.

exchanges.q: What happened on the night of July 9th?
a: For the second time, they stopped my bus. Two men got on with guns.
They took the money from the passengers and hit me in the face with a gun.

exchanges.q: Earlier you said they stopped your bus. Was that the first time?
exchanges.a: No, it was the second time. The first time was in June, but that time they only threatened me.
I did not know their names, but I think they were from the {GROUP}. They had the same tattoos.
My boss said that the company already paid the gang, and that I should not make problems.

exchanges.q: When did you leave your country?
exchanges.a: Three weeks after the second attack, at the beginning of August 2022.
